source_user: Choose between tensor and pipeline parallelism for a latency-sensitive multi-GPU service. State the assumptions needed. Scenario variant 103: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: compare per-GPU memory, communication topology, layer partitioning, batch and microbatch behavior, synchronization, latency target, and failure/reconfiguration costs.
corrected_answer:
Scenario variant 103: the prompt is under-specified, so do not choose tensor parallelism (TP) or pipeline parallelism (PP) without measurements. Assume a fixed model/checkpoint, precision, GPU count and type, usable memory in GiB, placement and interconnect topology, runtime/driver versions, clock and power policy, request prompt/output-length distributions, offered load, concurrency, batching policy, and explicit p50/p95/p99 end-to-end, TTFT, and TPOT targets in ms. Define throughput units, quality/correctness gates, error and availability budgets, and whether rank failure or reconfiguration is permitted; label unknowns as assumptions rather than platform facts.

Pre-register this falsifiable hypothesis before tuning: at a named offered load and fixed gates, the selected feasible configuration will reduce held-out p99 end-to-end latency by at least M ms or M% versus the best feasible alternative, without violating memory, quality, error, or availability limits. Enumerate feasible TP degrees and PP layer partitions. For TP, measure shard memory, collective type/bytes/duration, topology placement, synchronization and straggler waits. For PP, measure balanced per-stage compute, activation memory, inter-stage transfer time, microbatch count, pipeline bubble fraction, queueing, and synchronization. Also measure throughput, TTFT, TPOT, p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU memory/utilization/power, network traffic, OOMs, timeouts, retries, dropped requests, and recovery/reconfiguration time with units.

Use randomized interleaved paired trials on identical warmed replicas and the same replayable request trace. Reserve disjoint tuning and held-out traces, repeat enough runs for confidence intervals, and report the effect and uncertainty rather than a single best run. Control warm-up/compilation, caches, clocks, thermal state, placement, software, request mix, concurrency, and batch/microbatch policy; stratify by input/output length and load. Specifically, choose only among configurations that satisfy capacity, latency, reliability, and operational constraints, and distinguish measured telemetry from estimates.

Adopt a configuration only if held-out quality, correctness, memory, error, availability, and latency gates pass. Test bounded worker-loss/timeout failure injection only in an authorized isolated environment; record detection, cleanup, fallback, and recovery. Canary behind an approved reversible switch, cap load and blast radius, retain the known-good configuration, and roll back on any gate breach, instability, unexpected cost, or failed recovery. Domain-expert review and actual benchmark measurements remain required; this is provisional, not authoritative.

Minimum technical points: compare per-GPU memory, communication topology, layer partitioning, batch and microbatch behavior, synchronization, latency target, and failure/reconfiguration costs.
corrected_answer:
Scenario variant 113: the prompt is under-specified, so do not choose tensor parallelism (TP) or pipeline parallelism (PP) without measurements. Assume a fixed model/checkpoint, precision, GPU count and type, usable memory in GiB, placement and interconnect topology, runtime/driver versions, clock and power policy, request prompt/output-length distributions, offered load, concurrency, batching policy, and explicit p50/p95/p99 end-to-end, TTFT, and TPOT targets in ms. Define throughput units, quality/correctness gates, error and availability budgets, and whether rank failure or reconfiguration is permitted; label unknowns as assumptions rather than platform facts.

Pre-register this falsifiable hypothesis before tuning: at a named offered load and fixed gates, the selected feasible configuration will reduce held-out p99 end-to-end latency by at least M ms or M% versus the best feasible alternative, without violating memory, quality, error, or availability limits. Enumerate feasible TP degrees and PP layer partitions. For TP, measure shard memory, collective type/bytes/duration, topology placement, synchronization and straggler waits. For PP, measure balanced per-stage compute, activation memory, inter-stage transfer time, microbatch count, pipeline bubble fraction, queueing, and synchronization. Also measure throughput, TTFT, TPOT, p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU memory/utilization/power, network traffic, OOMs, timeouts, retries, dropped requests, and recovery/reconfiguration time with units.

Use randomized interleaved paired trials on identical warmed replicas and the same replayable request trace. Reserve disjoint tuning and held-out traces, repeat enough runs for confidence intervals, and report the effect and uncertainty rather than a single best run. Control warm-up/compilation, caches, clocks, thermal state, placement, software, request mix, concurrency, and batch/microbatch policy; stratify by input/output length and load. Specifically, diagnose whether collectives, stage imbalance, pipeline bubbles, queueing, or memory pressure is the limiting mechanism, and distinguish measured telemetry from estimates.

Adopt a configuration only if held-out quality, correctness, memory, error, availability, and latency gates pass. Test bounded worker-loss/timeout failure injection only in an authorized isolated environment; record detection, cleanup, fallback, and recovery. Canary behind an approved reversible switch, cap load and blast radius, retain the known-good configuration, and roll back on any gate breach, instability, unexpected cost, or failed recovery. Domain-expert review and actual benchmark measurements remain required; this is provisional, not authoritative.

quality_dimensions.coverage: covers assumptions, mechanism tradeoffs, boundaries, failure modes, measurement plan, and safety limits
quality_dimensions.technical_correctness: conditional comparison; no unsupported platform claim
quality_dimensions.experimental_rigor: pre-registered hypothesis, randomized paired trials, disjoint holdout, uncertainty and confounder controls
quality_dimensions.actionability: gated canary and reversible rollback procedure

risks: hardware/topology and workload assumptions may not hold
tail latency can be distorted by queueing, batching, or insufficient trace volume
failure testing may be unsafe without explicit authorization
evidence_required: measured memory and communication telemetry for candidate TP/PP configurations
held-out p50/p95/p99, TTFT, TPOT and throughput with confidence intervals
quality/error/availability gate results and authorized recovery test results
